_comment: Watchlist for competitor outlier mining (/competitors/mine). Each week the miner pulls each channel's recent SHORTS, finds the ones that beat that channel's OWN median views (an outlier - a breakout, normalized per channel so a small channel is judged fairly against a giant one), and distills the transferable topic/angle patterns into competitor_signals.json, which the topic generator reads as inspiration. It NEVER copies titles. Edit this list freely: add a channel with either a channel_id (UC...) or a handle (@name) - at least one is required; the miner resolves and validates each at runtime and reports any it could not resolve. 'tier' is documentation only: 'core' = pure single-fact/curiosity Shorts in this channel's exact format; 'benchmark' = large mixed fact channels included for reach signal (only their Shorts count).

channels.name: Zack D. Films
channels.note: The format benchmark: single animated fact per Short, body/space/how-things-work, ~28M subs.

channels.name: Factnomenal
channels.note: Space and cosmic curiosity Shorts, ~800K subs.

channels.name: FactoFusion
channels.note: Creepy/shocking/mysterious world facts, heavy Shorts output.

channels.name: Body Hub
channels.note: Human body hacks and facts - overlaps your body/brain category.

channels.name: FactTechz
channels.note: Amazing facts across nature/tech/psychology, ~21M subs; high-reach benchmark.

channels.name: MostAmazingTop10
channels.note: Mysterious/strange/scary facts, ~7.8M subs; benchmark (its Shorts only).

channels.name: American Eye
channels.note: Interesting topics and perfectly-timed phenomena, ~940K subs; benchmark.
